messages.author: Antti Korhonen
messages.text: Jarmo, voice VLAN 210 dropped on ACC-12 about ten minutes after the template v7 push. Phones on floor 3 are offline. The data VLAN is fine.

messages.author: Jarmo Heikkinen
messages.text: v7 changed the voice VLAN range. Tuula approved the change last week so it was meant to be safe, but let's roll ACC-12 back to the v6 template.

messages.author: Antti Korhonen
messages.text: Do I do it or do you?

messages.author: Jarmo Heikkinen
messages.text: I'll do it from the controller, give me five minutes.

messages.author: Jarmo Heikkinen
messages.text: Rolled back to v6 and saved it to the startup config. VLAN 210 is back on all ports.

messages.author: Antti Korhonen
messages.text: Phones are registering again, confirmed on floor 3.

messages.author: Antti Korhonen
messages.text: Did you see the email about the sauna evening? It is on again.

messages.author: Jarmo Heikkinen
messages.text: Ha, yes. I will write the change note.
